primary_question: Can a learner select and compose a reusable, role-neutral causal PROGRAM topology, not merely fit weights of a supplied fixed polynomial degree, from complete interleaved multi-entity FIT trajectories?
hidden_generator: independently authored source-only program topology, seed and operator assignment; FIT/CHECK/holdout public roles, events and initial states only; hidden operator never passed to learner

algorithm.grammar: program = op_outer(op_inner(argA,argB),argC); 4x4x6x6x6=3456 programs including equivalent expressions; canonical program identity and FIT-only exact consistent selection
algorithm.fit_training: evaluate all public FIT trajectory oracle outputs in TRAIN teacher-forced state, then eliminate inconsistent programs; CHECK and heldout full eight-event autoregressive predictions with no ground truth updates
algorithm.selection: first consistent program in preregistered lexical grammar order; ambiguity and witness disagreement reported, CHECK only veto; no post-result retuning

strong_controls: separately implemented, fully exhaustive pooled 3456-program search with same operands, primitives, 24 FIT and check; no candidate import
independent directed role-pair exhaustive per-edge program discovery (same full grammar; weaker inductive bias but fully trained, not a weak baseline)
frozen F124-CT fully trained 8D/45epoch gated recurrent role memory, identical public episode FIT and CHECK
out_of_primitive_family: uses modular multiplication and multi-input carry combinations; cannot claim generality if oracle belongs to declared grammar; all no-fit and no-veto histories preserved.
metrics: HELDOUT 8/8 full positive and 8 matched hard negatives
whole OS user+system CPU and peak RSS with five independent process repeats per arm/case
true model-source operator identity never exposed to learner
paired strong pool/control equal work nonregression assessed but no FLOP equivalence assumed

criteria.engineering_positive: at least one genuine unseen synthetic program family admits both shared program learners naturally and achieves >0 full unseen exact trajectories and zero hard false positives
